hazards.evidence: A tall wardrobe with mirrored doors stands near the window, angled toward the bed, creating a large reflective surface facing the sleeping area which could be misperceived as another person or room.
A dark, high-contrast patterned area rug lies on the light-colored floor in the hallway just outside the bedroom, which could be misread as a hole or obstacle.
